Visa Comparison FAQs

Which visa has the fastest processing time?
Processing times vary based on demand, occupation, and individual circumstances. Please check the Department of Home Affairs website for current processing timeframes.
Can I apply for multiple visas at the same time?
While technically possible, it's generally not recommended as it may complicate your applications. Consult a registered migration agent for advice specific to your situation.
Do all skilled visas require a skills assessment?
Most skilled visas require a positive skills assessment for your nominated occupation. Requirements vary by occupation and assessing authority.
What is the difference between PR and provisional visas?
PR (Permanent Resident) visas like 189 and 190 grant immediate permanent residency. Provisional visas like 491 are temporary and require meeting certain conditions before applying for PR.
Can I include family members in my application?
Yes, most skilled visas allow you to include eligible family members (partner, children) in your application. Each has specific requirements.
